panelChannel.description: Default channel of the ticket panel (/ticket-panel can post it elsewhere).

category.description: Category ticket channels are created in. Without it, at the top of the channel list.

staffRoles.description: Roles that see every ticket and can close them (the server owner and Cicord admins count as staff too). To use the staff portal routes they also need the moderator access level (spec.access.moderators of the server).

logChannel.description: Staff channel that receives a summary of each closed ticket. No summary without it.

panel.description: The message with the "open a ticket" button.

description.default: Click the button below to open a private ticket with the team.

welcomeMessage.description: First message of a ticket. Placeholders: {member}, {staff}, {subject}, {number}.
welcomeMessage.default: Hi {member}, thanks for reaching out! {staff} will be with you shortly.

maxOpenPerMember.description: Open tickets a member may have at the same time.

labels.description: Labels members pick when they open a ticket from the portal, and staff set on tickets. Tickets store the key: renaming a label keeps them, changing its key does not.

key.description: Stable identifier: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

emoji.description: Optional emoji shown before the name.
